chapterInfo.content:
10
Saulo wuo
(1 Samuel 31.1-13)
1 # 1 Sa 31 Na Filistifoɔ ne Israel koeɛ. Na Israel mmarima no dwanee wɔ Filistifoɔ anim, na wɔtotɔe wɔ Gilboa bepɔ so. 2Na Filistifoɔ tu saa Saulo ne ne mma, na Filistifoɔ kumm Yonatan, Abinadab ne Malkisua a wɔyɛ Saulo mma no. 3Na ɔko no den Saulo so, na agyantofoɔ bɛtoo no, na agyantofoɔ no too agyan wɔɔ no. 4Na Saulo ka kyerɛɛ n’akodeɛkurani sɛ: Twe wo nkrantɛ na fa wɔ me, na momonotofoɔ yi amma ammɛbɔ me adapaa. Na n’akodeɛkurani no ampene, na ɔsuroo pii. Enti Saulo faa ne nkrantɛ na ɔhwee so. 5Na n’akodeɛkurani no hunuu sɛ Saulo atɔ no, ɔno nso hwee ne nkrantɛ so na ɔtɔe. 6Na Saulo wui, na ne mma baasa no ne ne fiefoɔ nyinaa totɔɔ prɛko. 7Na Israelfoɔ a wɔwɔ bonhwa no mu nyinaa hunuu sɛ asraafoɔ no adwaneɛ, na Saulo ne ne mma atotɔ no, wɔgyigyaa wɔn nkuro hɔ dwanee. Na Filistifoɔ ba bɛtenatenaa mu.
8Na ɛbaa sɛ adeɛ kyeeɛ no, Filistifoɔ baa atɔfoɔ no ho nnoɔma yiyie, na wɔhunuu Saulo ne ne mma baasa no sɛ wɔatotɔ Gilboa bepɔ soɔ. 9Na wɔyiyii wɔn ho nnoɔma, na wɔfaa ne ti ne n’akodeɛ soma maa wɔde kyinii Filistifoɔ asase so, sɛ wɔnkɔpae nkyerɛ wɔn ahoni ne ɔman no. 10Na wɔde n’akodeɛ no kɔsiee wɔn anyame fie, na ne tikwankoraa deɛ, wɔde kɔfam Dagon fie. 11Na Yabes-gileadfoɔ nyinaa tee deɛ Filistifoɔ ayɛ Saulo nyinaa no, 12#2 Sa 2.5 akofoɔ no nyinaa sɔresɔree, na wɔkɔfaa Saulo amu, ne ne mma no amu no, na wɔde baa Yabes, na wɔbɛsiee wɔn nnompe no dupɔn a ɛwɔ Yabes no ase, na wɔdii mmuada nnanson. 13#1 Sa 15.11; 28.8 Na Saulo wui ne fom a ɔfom AWURADE no, ne AWURADE asɛm a wanni soɔ no, ne sɛ nso ɔkɔbisaa samanfrɛni hɔ adeɛ hwehwɛɛ n’akyiri kwan. 14Na wanhwehwɛ AWURADE akyiri kwan nti, na ɔkumm no, na ɔdanee ahennie no maa Yisai ba Dawid.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
